label: D1 reward after a non-rewarded trial, agent about to choose a2, mid-episode
explanation: Fires only at D1, only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a2 (99.7% of mass). The upcoming choice is the agent own computed choice, not a future random outcome; the observed-only version using prev_action == 2 instead scores F1 0.55 on dev, vs 0.60 for this one. Within those steps it prefers a reward that comes right after an unrewarded trial (a first reward after a miss): adding tv(prev_reward,-1)==0 raises dev precision from 0.16 to 0.54. It also depends strongly on position in the episode: activity is concentrated on episode trials ~30-70 and nearly absent before trial 20 and after trial 80, which looks like a slow drift in the hidden state, not a task variable. It never fires at GO or D2, or on unrewarded D1. Activations on the window first trial (rel -3) cannot be explained by in-window history, which caps recall. On dev: precision 0.54, recall 0.67, F1 0.60, mass recall 0.71. Magnitude not characterised beyond that.
